messages.S3「40Y-3充電」で充電回数を補給して嫉妬脆弱を入れ、次のターンに嫉妬共鳴3: A Blunt attacker that replenishes Charge Count and inflicts Envy Fragility with S3 40Y-3 Charge, then spends all that Count on S2 Charge Countercurrent next turn with at least 3 Envy Resonance. Built for longer fights, growing stronger as repeated spending raises Charge Potency.
messages.S3「40Y-3充電」(起点): Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に、それぞれ(充電+4/5: **S3 — 40Y-3 Charge (starter)**: On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each gain Charge Count equal to (Charge+4/5), up to 7/8 each. On hit, Coin Ⅳ inflicts 1 Envy Fragility next turn, plus 1 more with at least 2 Charge. Gains +2 Coin Power with at least 2 Charge / +1 per Charge, up to 4. It replenishes Count even early on when she has no Charge Potency.
messages.S2「充電逆流」(決め手): 使用時に充電回数が5以上10未満なら、不足分を体力: **S2 — Charge Countercurrent (finisher)**: On use, if her Charge Count is at least 5 but below 10, she pays the shortfall with HP to bring it to 10, spending 2×(10 − current Charge Count)% of her max HP. She then spends 10 for +1/2 Coin Power. If Resonance including this skill is 3 or more, Coin Ⅲ spends all remaining Charge Count and gains +(Charge+3/+4)% damage per Count spent, up to 60/120/180%.
messages.バトルパッシブ「電流解体」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 累計で充電回数1: **Combat passive — Electrocurrent Dismantling (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains 1 Charge each time she spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. With at least 2 Charge, deals +(Charge×3)% damage, up to 15%, plus another +(Charge×5)% against targets below 50% HP, up to 25%. Defeating an enemy increases the Charge Count of herself and the 1/2 allies with the least Charge Count by (2+Charge), up to 3/5.
messages.嫉妬共鳴: S2と守備「充電」が嫉妬。S2のⅢコインを活かすには、嫉妬スキルを並: **Envy Resonance**: S2 and the Defense skill Charge are Envy. Making use of Coin Ⅲ of S2 requires a team that can line up Envy skills.
messages.S1「40Y-3稼働」: 使用時に充電回数を5消耗してコイン威力+1/2、Ⅱコイ: **S1 — 40Y-3 Activation**: On use, spends 5 Charge Count for +1/2 Coin Power, and Coin Ⅱ adds +2/3 Count. It is a net loss of Count, so hold it back when you want to save Count for S2.
messages.序盤はS3(または守備「充電」)で充電回数を貯め、S3の嫉妬脆弱が入った次のター: Early on, build Charge Count with S3 or the Defense skill Charge, and on the turn after S3's Envy Fragility lands, use S2 at 3 or more Envy Resonance. Aiming to grow Charge to around 3 through repeated spending is a reasonable target. She tends to run short on Count, so look for the resupply from defeating enemies. She pairs well with allies who can supply Charge Count, such as Heathcliff's MultiCrack Office Fixer. Her HP and Defense Level are low, and S2's HP cost adds up, so be careful about taking hits.
